# Switch

An on/off that applies immediately, with the thumb as the second cue.

In `library/components/switch/` — copy `component.{html,css,js}`, read `docs.md` for why.

**Root:** `.ac-switch`

## ARIA

- **the input** — `type=checkbox` `aria-describedby`
- **the drawn track** — `aria-hidden=true`

## Keyboard

- `Tab` — native: one stop per switch — the drawn track is not focusable
- `Enter` — native: submits the form if there is one. It never toggles
- `Space` — native: toggles the focused switch

**States:** on, off, disabled

## Goes wrong when

- the track color as the only cue, so the state is carried by color alone (SC 1.4.1)
- role=switch reached for by default — it announces inconsistently in older JAWS
- a switch that needs a Save button, which should have been a checkbox
- the real input hidden with display:none, which removes the keyboard route
- disabled rather than aria-disabled when the person needs to know why

**API:** `AC.createSwitch(root, options) -> { set, state, refresh, input, destroy }`

WCAG 1.3.1 1.4.1 1.4.11 2.1.1 2.4.7 2.5.8 3.2.2 4.1.2 4.1.3 · [APG](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/switch/) · see also `checkbox`, `chip-toggle`, `motion-preferences`
